stpa_analysis.controller: Supervised peer state machine and independent reviewers
stpa_analysis.control_action: Route bounded frames, accept exact transport reports and evaluate monotonic freshness

ucas.context: Freshness evaluation stops when queued transport work cannot progress.
ucas.constraint: Commit monotonic freshness independently of outbound/UTC refusal.

ucas.context: A frame is misrouted or a wrong report retires another outstanding frame.
ucas.constraint: Configured sender equality and exact lifetime/id/destination matching; retain bytes on failures.

ucas.context: Replayed remote timestamps rearm a tripped peer.
ucas.constraint: Only strictly advancing remote activity watermark may record a local-monotonic heartbeat.

ucas.context: Actor work or effects escape bounded state and current execution authority.
ucas.constraint: Bound configuration/queues/advisories/child calls; no network I/O or effect dispatch; supervise and hand off retained state at controlled shutdown.

fmea_modes.cause: Queue transfer, destination matching or freshness-clock coupling can discard retained work or falsely refresh stale peers if composed into runtime.
fmea_modes.effect: Lost updates or false peer-health clearance.
fmea_modes.controls: Opaque state, atomic typed refusal, retained addressed IDs, epoch watermarks, independent monotonic timer, negative controls and separate integration review.

decision.summary: Implement bounded opaque peer loop with retained routed outbox, strict routing checks, replay-independent local deadman clock, and supervised actor. Parent PROGRAM coordinates later transport.
alternatives: Repair gaps and execute revision-bound checks
assumptions: User authorizes completing and admitting existing EVs; evidence requirements remain in force.
counterevidence: Only synthetic EV999 exists in the legacy evidence table; actual EV evidence must be obtained.
decision.forecast: Negative tests will expose unsupported admission and fixed-positive verification; genuine runtime/formal obligations may require additional scoped work.
decision.falsifier: Any missing, tampered, stale, wrong-candidate or nonpassing evidence is accepted for admission.
decision.rollback: Preserve failed receipts and immutable work. Do not rewrite shared journal/cycle history or replace runtime without its own checked fence and recovery path.
decision.budget: Existing realized tools only; no package downloads or paid inference. Two build jobs, two BEAM schedulers per probe, bounded subprocess timeouts; stage-specific execution ceilings recorded with receipts.
decision.reviewer: Independent code review and actual Codex/AGY sovereign review; no model impersonation.
